name: Felidar
description: A huge hairless, antlered guardian beast that ambushes Nahiri and is killed.

description_citations.work: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave

timeline.summary: A felidar ambushes Nahiri in a darkened chamber; Nissa distracts it and Nahiri chains and kills it.
timeline.quote: Nahiri drove all seven blades into the felidar, making certain to hit its vulnerable points this time.

relations.note: She stabs it with seven swords.
relations.quote: The creature shrieked once, a long and terrible cry, and then went limp.
